fusions.name: Paired Rivets
fusions.desc: Fires 2 rivets in a narrow spread out to 7 tiles, each of which deals 3 damage.

fusions.name: Measured Twice
fusions.desc: Fires a bolt at an enemy up to 8 tiles away that deals 28 damage, rising to 2 times that at maximum range. The damage ignores armour.

fusions.name: Quick-Change Tooling
fusions.desc: Clears the cooldown on one of your other abilities, chosen at random from those still waiting. You move 15% faster for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Running Tally
fusions.desc: Every time you use an ability, a stack builds on you, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 4% of your maximum health per stack (25% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
